subject: [PATCH 4/8] selftests/mm: check that MADV_COLD and MADV_PAGEOUT reject hugetlb

2026-10-14.patch_summary: This patch adds a test to the selftests/mm suite to ensure that madvise(2) fails with EINVAL when attempting to apply MADV_COLD or MADV_PAGEOUT hints to hugetlb memory. The test creates a hugetlb mapping, sets one of its bytes, and then attempts to advise it with both hints, verifying that the calls fail as expected.
